content: actions/deploy-pages exposes one output: page_url (URL of deployed Pages site). Wire via step id deployment, environment url ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}. Required job permissions: pages: write, id-token: write. To consume in a later job, declare job-level outputs: page_url: ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }} and read needs.deploy.outputs.page_url.
